Ravi N: We need a plan for v2 darklaunch where streaming routes keep billing to v1 but v2 emits extra tokens for metadata. Thoughts?
Claire H: Streaming makes reconciliation messy. Best to emit per-chunk billing increments to v1_quota so consoles show live numbers.
Omar Z: Add server-side dedupe for chunk resends (60s window) so we don't double-bill on flaky clients.
Ravi N: Agreed. Also map v2 model IDs to v1 billing IDs in a runtime mapping table. It must be editable but audited.
Claire H: Telemetry: compat.stream_token_delta, compat.dark_pct, compat.error_ratio. Alerts if delta > 7% for 10m.
Omar Z: Auto-reduce rule: if p95 latency for dark cohort > SLO*1.25 or error_ratio > 1.5 -> halve percent and post incident. Emit rollout.autoreduce.reason for audits.
Ravi N: Console: small badge "Darklaunch (stream-safe)" + reconciliation view overlaying billed vs observed tokens.
Claire H: Implementation sketch: startBillingSession -> for each chunk estimate tokens -> session.increment(v1_key) -> route to v2. Ensure increment is idempotent.
ops-bot: Feature-flag guard applied: max change 25% per 10m for streaming routes.
Omar Z: Owners: Claire -> dedupe + console mock, Ravi -> mapping API + RFC, Omar -> alerts & autoreduce impl.
Ravi N: I'll open RFC and schedule 30m sync. No objections?
Claire H: SGTM.
Omar Z: SGTM.
